chunks: I will leave you and those you invoke apart from God, and pray to my Lord. Haply in praying to my Lord I will not be deprived.

key_terms.وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ: I will separate myself from you

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Zakariyya's statement about separating from those he worships besides God?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Zakariyya (AS) articulates the principle of *I'tizal* (separation) from polytheists to preserve monotheistic purity, a concept central to Shia theological discourse on distinguishing truth from falsehood. His plea, 'perhaps I will not be wretched in the supplication of my Lord,' reflects the Shia emphasis on *Tawhid* and the confidence in divine acceptance of sincere, exclusive devotion. This moment marks a decisive break from communal idolatry, underscoring the individual's responsibility to seek God directly.
